Genesis 1:1.text:
In the beginning, God created the heavens and the
earth.

Genesis 1:27.text:
God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male
and female he created them.

Genesis 28:15.text:
Behold, I am with you, and will keep you, wherever you go, and will
bring you again into this land. For I will not leave you until I have done that which I have spoken of
to you.”

Exodus 15:2.text:
The LORD is my strength and song.
He has become my salvation.
This is my God, and I will praise him;
my father’s God, and I will exalt him.

Exodus 20:12.text:
“Honour your father and your mother, that your days may be long
in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

Exodus 33:14.text:
He said, “My presence will go with you, and I will give you
rest.”

Numbers 6:24-26.text:
‘The LORD bless you, and keep you. The LORD make his face to shine on you,
and be gracious to you. The LORD lift up his face towards you,
and give you peace.’

Numbers 23:19.text:
God is not a man, that he should lie,
nor a son of man, that he should repent.
Has he said, and he won’t do it?
Or has he spoken, and he won’t make it good?

Deuteronomy 6:5.text:
You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul,
and with all your might.

Deuteronomy 7:9.text:
Know therefore that the LORD your God himself is God, the faithful God,
who keeps covenant and loving kindness to a thousand generations with those who love him and keep his
commandments,

Deuteronomy 8:3.text:
He humbled you, allowed you to be hungry, and fed you with manna, which
you didn’t know, neither did your fathers know, that he might teach you that man does not live by bread
only, but man lives by every word that proceeds out of the LORD’s mouth.

Deuteronomy 31:6.text:
Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for the
LORD your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”

Deuteronomy 31:8.text:
The LORD himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will
not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.”

Joshua 1:8.text:
This book of the law shall not depart from your mouth, but you shall meditate
on it day and night, that you may observe to do according to all that is written in it; for then you shall
make your way prosperous, and then you shall have good success.

Joshua 1:9.text:
Haven’t I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid. Don’t
be dismayed, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.”

Joshua 24:15.text:
If it seems evil to you to serve the LORD, choose today whom you will
serve; whether the gods which your fathers served that were beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites,
in whose land you dwell; but as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.”

1 Samuel 12:24.text:
Only fear the LORD, and serve him in truth with all your heart; for
consider what great things he has done for you.

1 Samuel 16:7.text:
But the LORD said to Samuel, “Don’t look on his face, or on the
height of his stature, because I have rejected him; for I don’t see as man sees. For man looks at the
outward appearance, but the LORD looks at the heart.”

2 Samuel 22:31.text:
As for God, his way is perfect.
The LORD’s word is tested.
He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

1 Kings 8:61.text:
“Let your heart therefore be perfect with the LORD our God, to
walk in his statutes, and to keep his commandments, as it is today.”

1 Chronicles 16:11.text:
Seek the LORD and his strength.
Seek his face forever more.

1 Chronicles 16:34.text:
Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good,
for his loving kindness endures forever.

1 Chronicles 28:20.text:
David said to Solomon his son, “Be strong and courageous, and
do it. Don’t be afraid, nor be dismayed, for the LORD God, even my God, is with you. He will not fail
you nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of the LORD’s house is finished.

1 Chronicles 29:11.text:
Yours, LORD, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and
the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours. Yours is the kingdom, LORD, and
you are exalted as head above all.

2 Chronicles 15:7.text:
But you be strong! Don’t let your hands be slack, for your work will
be rewarded.”

Nehemiah 8:10.text:
Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and
send portions to him for whom nothing is prepared, for today is holy to our Lord. Don’t be grieved, for
the joy of the LORD is your strength.”

Job 12:13.text:
“With God is wisdom and might.
He has counsel and understanding.

Job 19:25.text:
But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives.
In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

Job 23:10.text:
But he knows the way that I take.
When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.

Job 28:28.text:
To man he said,
‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom.
To depart from evil is understanding.’”

Psalm 1:1-2.text:
Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked,
nor stand on the path of sinners,
nor sit in the seat of scoffers; but his delight is in the LORD’s
law.
On his law he meditates day and night.

Psalm 1:3.text:
He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water,
that produces its fruit in its season,
whose leaf also does not wither.
Whatever he does shall prosper.

Psalm 4:8.text:
In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep,
for you alone, the LORD, make me live in safety.

Psalm 5:3.text:
LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice.
In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

Psalm 16:8.text:
I have set the LORD always before me.
Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

Psalm 16:11.text:
You will show me the path of life.
In your presence is fullness of joy.
In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

Psalm 18:30.text:
As for God, his way is perfect.
The LORD’s word is tried.
He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

Psalm 19:1.text:
The heavens declare the glory of God.
The expanse shows his handiwork.

Psalm 19:14.text:
Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart
be acceptable in your sight,
LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.

Psalm 20:7.text:
Some trust in chariots, and some in horses,
but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.

Psalm 23:1.text:
The LORD is my shepherd;
I shall lack nothing.

Psalm 23:4.text:
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death,
I will fear no evil, for you are with me.
Your rod and your staff,
they comfort me.

Psalm 23:6.text:
Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days
of my life,
and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.

Psalm 25:4-5.text:
Show me your ways, LORD.
Teach me your paths. Guide me in your truth, and teach me,
For you are the God of my salvation.
I wait for you all day long.

Psalm 27:1.text:
The LORD is my light and my salvation.
Whom shall I fear?
The LORD is the strength of my life.
Of whom shall I be afraid?

Psalm 27:4.text:
One thing I have asked of the LORD, that I will seek after:
that I may dwell in the LORD’s house all the days of my life,
to see the LORD’s beauty,
and to enquire in his temple.

Psalm 27:14.text:
Wait for the LORD.
Be strong, and let your heart take courage.
Yes, wait for the LORD.

Psalm 28:7.text:
The LORD is my strength and my shield.
My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped.
Therefore my heart greatly rejoices.
With my song I will thank him.

Psalm 29:11.text:
The LORD will give strength to his people.
The LORD will bless his people with peace.

Psalm 30:5.text:
For his anger is but for a moment.
His favour is for a lifetime.
Weeping may stay for the night,
but joy comes in the morning.

Psalm 31:24.text:
Be strong, and let your heart take courage,
all you who hope in the LORD.

Psalm 32:8.text:
I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go.
I will counsel you with my eye on you.

Psalm 33:4.text:
For the LORD’s word is right.
All his work is done in faithfulness.

Psalm 34:4.text:
I sought the LORD, and he answered me,
and delivered me from all my fears.

Psalm 34:8.text:
Oh taste and see that the LORD is good.
Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

Psalm 34:18.text:
The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart,
and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

Psalm 37:4.text:
Also delight yourself in the LORD,
and he will give you the desires of your heart.

Psalm 37:5.text:
Commit your way to the LORD.
Trust also in him, and he will do this:

Psalm 37:7.text:
Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him.
Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way,
because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

Psalm 37:23-24.text:
A man’s steps are established by the LORD.
He delights in his way. Though he stumble, he shall not fall,
for the LORD holds him up with his hand.

Psalm 39:4.text:
“LORD, show me my end,
what is the measure of my days.
Let me know how frail I am.

Psalm 40:1-2.text:
I waited patiently for the LORD.
He turned to me, and heard my cry. He brought me up also out of a horrible pit,
out of the miry clay.
He set my feet on a rock,
and gave me a firm place to stand.

Psalm 40:8.text:
I delight to do your will, my God.
Yes, your law is within my heart.”

Psalm 42:1-2.text:
As the deer pants for the water brooks,
so my soul pants after you, God. My soul thirsts for God, for the living God.
When shall I come and appear before God?

Psalm 42:11.text:
Why are you in despair, my soul?
Why are you disturbed within me?
Hope in God! For I shall still praise him,
the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

Psalm 46:1.text:
God is our refuge and strength,
a very present help in trouble.

Psalm 46:10.text:
“Be still, and know that I am God.
I will be exalted amongst the nations.
I will be exalted in the earth.”

Psalm 51:10.text:
Create in me a clean heart, O God.
Renew a right spirit within me.

Psalm 51:12.text:
Restore to me the joy of your salvation.
Uphold me with a willing spirit.

Psalm 55:22.text:
Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you.
He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

Psalm 56:3-4.text:
When I am afraid,
I will put my trust in you. In God, I praise his word.
In God, I put my trust.
I will not be afraid.
What can flesh do to me?

Psalm 62:1-2.text:
My soul rests in God alone.
My salvation is from him. He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress.
I will never be greatly shaken.

Psalm 62:8.text:
Trust in him at all times, you people.
Pour out your heart before him.
God is a refuge for us.
Selah.

Psalm 63:1.text:
God, you are my God.
I will earnestly seek you.
My soul thirsts for you.
My flesh longs for you,
in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

Psalm 68:19.text:
Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens,
even the God who is our salvation.
Selah.

Psalm 73:26.text:
My flesh and my heart fails,
but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

Psalm 84:10.text:
For a day in your courts is better than a thousand.
I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God,
than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

Psalm 84:11.text:
For the LORD God is a sun and a shield.
The LORD will give grace and glory.
He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

Psalm 86:5.text:
For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive,
abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

Psalm 86:11.text:
Teach me your way, LORD.
I will walk in your truth.
Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

Psalm 90:12.text:
So teach us to count our days,
that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

Psalm 90:17.text:
Let the favour of the Lord our God be on us.
Establish the work of our hands for us.
Yes, establish the work of our hands.

Psalm 91:11.text:
For he will put his angels in charge of you,
to guard you in all your ways.

Psalm 94:19.text:
In the multitude of my thoughts within me,
your comforts delight my soul.

Psalm 95:1-2.text:
Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD.
Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation! Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving.
Let’s extol him with songs!

Psalm 100:4-5.text:
Enter into his gates with thanksgiving,
and into his courts with praise.
Give thanks to him, and bless his name. For the LORD is good.
His loving kindness endures forever,
his faithfulness to all generations.

Psalm 101:3.text:
I will set no vile thing before my eyes.
I hate the deeds of faithless men.
They will not cling to me.

Psalm 103:1-2.text:
Praise the LORD, my soul!
All that is within me, praise his holy name! Praise the LORD, my soul,
and don’t forget all his benefits,

Psalm 103:8.text:
The LORD is merciful and gracious,
slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

Psalm 103:12.text:
As far as the east is from the west,
so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

Psalm 107:9.text:
For he satisfies the longing soul.
He fills the hungry soul with good.

Psalm 111:10.text:
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom.
All those who do his work have a good understanding.
His praise endures forever!

Psalm 112:7.text:
He will not be afraid of evil news.
His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.

Psalm 116:1-2.text:
I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice,
and my cries for mercy. Because he has turned his ear to me,
therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

Psalm 118:6.text:
The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid.
What can man do to me?

Psalm 118:24.text:
This is the day that the LORD has made.
We will rejoice and be glad in it!

Psalm 119:9.text:
How can a young man keep his way pure?
By living according to your word.

Psalm 119:11.text:
I have hidden your word in my heart,
that I might not sin against you.

Psalm 119:18.text:
Open my eyes,
that I may see wondrous things out of your law.

Psalm 119:37.text:
Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things.
Revive me in your ways.

Psalm 119:105.text:
Your word is a lamp to my feet,
and a light for my path.

Psalm 119:114.text:
You are my hiding place and my shield.
I hope in your word.

Psalm 119:130.text:
The entrance of your words gives light.
It gives understanding to the simple.

Psalm 119:133.text:
Establish my footsteps in your word.
Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.

Psalm 119:165.text:
Those who love your law have great peace.
Nothing causes them to stumble.

Psalm 121:1-2.text:
I will lift up my eyes to the hills.
Where does my help come from? My help comes from the LORD,
who made heaven and earth.

Psalm 121:7-8.text:
The LORD will keep you from all evil.
He will keep your soul. The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in,
from this time forward, and forever more.

Psalm 126:3.text:
The LORD has done great things for us,
and we are glad.

Psalm 127:1.text:
Unless the LORD builds the house,
they who build it labour in vain.
Unless the LORD watches over the city,
the watchman guards it in vain.

Psalm 127:2.text:
It is vain for you to rise up early,
to stay up late,
eating the bread of toil,
for he gives sleep to his loved ones.

Psalm 130:5.text:
I wait for the LORD.
My soul waits.
I hope in his word.

Psalm 133:1.text:
See how good and how pleasant it is
for brothers to live together in unity!

Psalm 136:1.text:
Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good,
for his loving kindness endures forever.

Psalm 138:8.text:
The LORD will fulfil that which concerns me.
Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever.
Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.

Psalm 139:13-14.text:
For you formed my inmost being.
You knit me together in my mother’s womb. I will give thanks to you,
for I am fearfully and wonderfully made.
Your works are wonderful.
My soul knows that very well.

Psalm 139:23-24.text:
Search me, God, and know my heart.
Try me, and know my thoughts. See if there is any wicked way in me,
and lead me in the everlasting way.

Psalm 141:3.text:
Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth.
Keep the door of my lips.

Psalm 143:8.text:
Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning,
for I trust in you.
Cause me to know the way in which I should walk,
for I lift up my soul to you.

Psalm 143:10.text:
Teach me to do your will,
for you are my God.
Your Spirit is good.
Lead me in the land of uprightness.

Psalm 145:8.text:
The LORD is gracious, merciful,
slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

Psalm 145:18.text:
The LORD is near to all those who call on him,
to all who call on him in truth.

Psalm 147:3.text:
He heals the broken in heart,
and binds up their wounds.

Psalm 150:6.text:
Let everything that has breath praise the LORD!
Praise the LORD!

Proverbs 1:7.text:
The fear of the LORD
is the beginning of knowledge,
but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

Proverbs 2:6.text:
For the LORD gives wisdom.
Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

Proverbs 3:5-6.text:
Trust in the LORD with all your heart,
and don’t lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him,
and he will make your paths straight.

Proverbs 3:13-14.text:
Happy is the man who finds wisdom,
the man who gets understanding. For her good profit is better than getting silver,
and her return is better than fine gold.

Proverbs 3:27.text:
Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due,
when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

Proverbs 4:7.text:
Wisdom is supreme.
Get wisdom.
Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

Proverbs 4:23.text:
Keep your heart with all diligence,
for out of it is the wellspring of life.

Proverbs 4:25-27.text:
Let your eyes look straight ahead.
Fix your gaze directly before you. Make the path of your feet level.
Let all of your ways be established. Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left.
Remove your foot from evil.

Proverbs 6:6-8.text:
Go to the ant, you sluggard.
Consider her ways, and be wise; which having no chief, overseer, or ruler, provides her bread in the summer,
and gathers her food in the harvest.

Proverbs 9:10.text:
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom.
The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

Proverbs 10:4.text:
He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand,
but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

Proverbs 10:9.text:
He who walks blamelessly walks surely,
but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

Proverbs 10:19.text:
In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience,
but he who restrains his lips does wisely.

Proverbs 11:2.text:
When pride comes, then comes shame,
but with humility comes wisdom.

Proverbs 11:25.text:
The liberal soul shall be made fat.
He who waters shall be watered also himself.

Proverbs 12:1.text:
Whoever loves correction loves knowledge,
but he who hates reproof is stupid.

Proverbs 12:11.text:
He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread,
but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.

Proverbs 12:24.text:
The hands of the diligent ones shall rule,
but laziness ends in slave labour.

Proverbs 13:4.text:
The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing,
but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.

Proverbs 13:20.text:
One who walks with wise men grows wise,
but a companion of fools suffers harm.

Proverbs 14:23.text:
In all hard work there is profit,
but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

Proverbs 14:29.text:
He who is slow to anger has great understanding,
but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

Proverbs 15:1.text:
A gentle answer turns away wrath,
but a harsh word stirs up anger.

Proverbs 15:3.text:
The LORD’s eyes are everywhere,
keeping watch on the evil and the good.

Proverbs 15:13.text:
A glad heart makes a cheerful face,
but an aching heart breaks the spirit.

Proverbs 15:22.text:
Where there is no counsel, plans fail;
but in a multitude of counsellors they are established.

Proverbs 15:33.text:
The fear of the LORD teaches wisdom.
Before honour is humility.

Proverbs 16:3.text:
Commit your deeds to the LORD,
and your plans shall succeed.

Proverbs 16:9.text:
A man’s heart plans his course,
but the LORD directs his steps.

Proverbs 16:18.text:
Pride goes before destruction,
and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

Proverbs 16:24.text:
Pleasant words are a honeycomb,
sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

Proverbs 16:32.text:
One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty;
one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

Proverbs 17:17.text:
A friend loves at all times;
and a brother is born for adversity.

Proverbs 17:22.text:
A cheerful heart makes good medicine,
but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

Proverbs 17:27.text:
He who spares his words has knowledge.
He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.

Proverbs 18:10.text:
The LORD’s name is a strong tower:
the righteous run to him, and are safe.

Proverbs 18:15.text:
The heart of the discerning gets knowledge.
The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

Proverbs 18:21.text:
Death and life are in the power of the tongue;
those who love it will eat its fruit.

Proverbs 19:20.text:
Listen to counsel and receive instruction,
that you may be wise in your latter end.

Proverbs 19:21.text:
There are many plans in a man’s heart,
but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.

Proverbs 20:4.text:
The sluggard will not plough by reason of the winter;
therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

Proverbs 21:5.text:
The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit;
and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.

Proverbs 21:21.text:
He who follows after righteousness and kindness
finds life, righteousness, and honour.

Proverbs 22:1.text:
A good name is more desirable than great riches,
and loving favour is better than silver and gold.

Proverbs 22:6.text:
Train up a child in the way he should go,
and when he is old he will not depart from it.

Proverbs 22:29.text:
Do you see a man skilled in his work?
He will serve kings.
He won’t serve obscure men.

Proverbs 23:12.text:
Apply your heart to instruction,
and your ears to the words of knowledge.

Proverbs 24:16.text:
for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again,
but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.

Proverbs 24:27.text:
Prepare your work outside,
and get your fields ready.
Afterwards, build your house.

Proverbs 25:28.text:
Like a city that is broken down and without walls
is a man whose spirit is without restraint.

Proverbs 27:1.text:
Don’t boast about tomorrow;
for you don’t know what a day may bring.

Proverbs 27:17.text:
Iron sharpens iron;
so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.

Proverbs 28:13.text:
He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper,
but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

Proverbs 28:19.text:
One who works his land will have an abundance of food;
but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.

Proverbs 29:11.text:
A fool vents all of his anger,
but a wise man brings himself under control.

Proverbs 29:25.text:
The fear of man proves to be a snare,
but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe.

Proverbs 30:5.text:
“Every word of God is flawless.
He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

Proverbs 31:30.text:
Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain;
but a woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised.

Ecclesiastes 3:1.text: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:

Ecclesiastes 3:11.text:
He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity
in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to
the end.

Ecclesiastes 4:9-10.text:
Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their
labour. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who
is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.

Ecclesiastes 7:8.text:
Better is the end of a thing than its beginning.
The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.

Ecclesiastes 7:9.text:
Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom
of fools.

Ecclesiastes 9:10.text:
Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with your might; for there is
no work, nor plan, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in Sheol, where you are going.

Ecclesiastes 11:4.text:
He who observes the wind won’t sow;
and he who regards the clouds won’t reap.

Ecclesiastes 12:1.text:
Remember also your Creator in the days of your youth,
before the evil days come, and the years draw near,
when you will say, “I have no pleasure in them;”

Ecclesiastes 12:13.text:
This is the end of the matter. All has been heard. Fear God
and keep his commandments; for this is the whole duty of man.

Isaiah 1:18.text:
“Come now, and let’s reason together,” says the LORD:
“Though your sins are as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow.
Though they are red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

Isaiah 9:6.text:
For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will
be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counsellor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince
of Peace.

Isaiah 12:2.text:
Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for
